title: Strict quotient tower and open tensor comparison interfaces
statement: For the completed coefficient categories, unbounded cochain complexes and strict positive quotient towers on schemes [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-integral-reduction-tower], define the strict open quotient tensor interfaces formerly declared in OpenTensorQuotientAugmentation. Towers and transpose retain every transition; Balanced retains its coefficient formula; Augmentation its homogeneous scalar-unit formula; ScalarCompatibility and ScalarComparison their actual coefficient-level normalizations. StrictSquare records balanced comparisons, finite coefficient-linear comparisons, their reduction equations, strict augmentation square and localized equality. RoosNormalization pins the augmentation to the first normalized tensor-completion coordinate. FiniteGeometry, FiniteExtensionModel, RestrictionPartitions and IntegralGeometry state the exact geometric properties. Comparison packages these with compatible ordinary and complete open comparisons. All are unchanged definitions or structures, with no existence assertion [def-sf-integral-open-operations, def-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison-data, def-sf-open-semilinear-tensor-model-data, def-sf-tensor-completion-comparison]. ScalarComponents names exactly the original degreewise ScalarComparison.components proposition, without altering its meaning.
